verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an in-client calendar: hit 2 for a full calendar view, a consolidated toggleable view of Gmail and Outlook calendars, a right-side day panel when an email mentions a date, a secondary time zone, and "Find Time" to see when teammates are free. Event creation is only implied by the Find Time and team scheduling features, and nothing documents responding to invites. missing for 10: evidence of accepting/declining calendar invites from within the client, explicit documentation of creating events in-app, independent or hands-on corroboration of the calendar features.
